data.title: Warner Bros. Discovery Announces Intention to Delist Euro Notes from Nasdaq Global
data.description: In a recent press release on September 25, 2026, Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc. (NASDAQ: WBD) revealed plans for its acquisition by Paramount Skydance Corporation ("PSKY"). data.title: Kodiak Sciences to Present Topline Results on September 28, 2026 from DAYBREAK Pivotal Phase 3 Study of Zenkuda and KSI-501 in Patients with Wet Age-Related Macular Degeneration
data.description: On Monday, September 28th at 8:30 AM Eastern Time, Kodiak Sciences Inc. based in PALO ALTO, Calif., will be hosting a webcast. data.title: Boo in the Bottoms Awakens Halloween in Kansas City from Daytime Delights to Nighttime Frights
data.description: Kansas City will kick off its Halloween festivities as the Historic West Bottoms opens Beast and Edge of Hell for the season. The Festival of the Full Moon, known as Boo in the Bottoms, will take place from October 2nd to 4th. This event marks the official start of Halloween in the city. The spooky celebrations will feature haunted attractions and various activities for visitors. The event is set to draw in crowds from near and far, making it a must-visit for thrill-seekers. Don't miss out on the fun at this year's Boo in the Bottoms from October 2nd to 4th in Kansas City.

data.title: Atlas Free Raises Over $1.6 Million at Most Successful Gala to Date to Fight Sex Trafficking Worldwide
data.description: A Seattle-based organization known as Atlas Free, dedicated to combating human trafficking worldwide, successfully raised a record-breaking amount of over $1.6 million during its recent 15th annual gala in Kirkland. The event, held in September 2026, marked the most lucrative gala in the history of the organization.

data.title: Diamond Certified Resource Publishes New Article About Paid Advertising Versus Earned Certifications
data.description: Using a rigorous research methodology, Diamond Certified distinguishes itself from paid advertising and user-generated reviews. Located in Petaluma, California, on September 25, 2026, American Ratings Corporation introduced the Diamond Certified Resource. data.title: Greenberg Traurig Recognized as 2026 Law360 Florida Regional Powerhouse
data.description: In its 10th consecutive year, Greenberg Traurig, P.A., a prominent global law firm established in Miami in 1967, has once again been acknowledged as a "Florida Regional Powerhouse" by Law360. This recognition highlights the firm's consistent success in representing clients in significant transactions and pivotal matters that influence the region.

data.title: FDA approves Lilly's Olumiant (baricitinib) for pediatric patients 12 years of age and older with severe alopecia areata
data.description: FDA approval was granted based on findings from BRAVE-AA-PEDS, the primary and most extensive Phase 3 trial focusing on pediatric individuals with severe alopecia areata (AA). Administering Olumiant led to significant regrowth of scalp hair and enhancements in eyebrow hair.

data.title: The Kenaitze Indian Tribe Notifies Individuals of Data Security Incident
data.description: In Kenai, Alaska on September 25, 2026, the Kenaitze Indian Tribe (KIT) announced a data security breach possibly involving protected health information. KIT is reaching out to potentially affected individuals to inform them of the incident and offer support. The breach occurred in July with an unknown number of individuals at risk. The tribe is taking steps to address the situation and ensure data security moving forward.

data.title: The John Cooper School Director of Wellness Publishes New Book on Cultivating Well-Being in Education
data.description: A new program called Beyond Thinking, developed by Dr. Juan-Diego Estrada, is introducing innovative ideas influenced by Cooper's Wisdom in Action method to educators and schools globally. The initiative is making waves in THE WOODLANDS, Texas, with its official launch date scheduled for September 25, 2026. This cutting-edge approach is being championed by the John Cooper School, which is recognizing its Director of Wellness, Dr. Juan-Diego, for his contribution to the field. This initiative aims to benefit school communities worldwide and is set to bring about positive change and development in education.

data.title: RefinedScience Expands Deep, Multimodal Pancreatic Cancer Dataset
data.description: AURORA, Colorado - RefinedScience revealed a new partnership agreement aiming to establish the Marsico Pancreatic Cancer Initiative as the largest multimodal single-cell pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) dataset globally by 2026. The initiative has secured access to over 2,000 consented pancreatic cancer samples from top academic and industry sources. Pancreatic cancer is known to be one of the most fatal major cancers.

data.title: CDW Completes Acquisition of Lovelytics
data.description: VERNON HILLS, Illinois - CDW (Nasdaq: CDW), a tech partner focusing on customer ambition, has finalized its acquisition of Lovelytics, a top data and AI services firm and part of the Databricks Brickbuilder Partner Network. This move aims to enhance CDW's Services & Solutions lineup. Lovelytics brings its expertise to a wider customer base, contributing to organizational growth.

data.title: Southland Receives Notice of Noncompliance with NYSE American Continued Listing Standards
data.description: In Grapevine, Texas, on September 23, 2026, Southland Holdings, Inc. (NYSE American: SLND and SLND WS) was informed by NYSE Regulation of NYSE American LLC that they no longer meet the listing criteria. The Notice cited non-compliance with Sections 1003(a)(i) and 1003(a)(ii) of NYSE American's standards. This notification impacts the Company's trading status on the stock exchange and raises concerns about their future market presence.
